title: Crochet Puff Stitch Flower
name: Puff Flower
seoTitle: Crochet Puff Stitch Flower Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet puff stitch flower pattern: a dc ring, six puff stitches and a round of sc and dc petals. Quick, flat and printable. Free PDF download.
lead: A flat, soft flower made with six puff stitches. It works up in four rounds and makes a cute appliqué or keychain.
yarn: Cotton yarn in one or two colours

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in one or two colours

notes: Puff (6 loops): (yarn over, insert hook, pull up a loop) until you have 6 loops on the hook, yarn over and pull through all of them.

rounds.text: ch 4 (counts as dc + ch 1), (dc, ch 1) x5, sl st to the 3rd ch.
ch 3, (puff in the ch-1 space, ch 1) x6, sl st.
(sc, 2 dc, sc) in each ch-1 space x6. Fasten off.
